song.lyrics:
[V1] . C D There is a candle in every soul . C G D Some brightly burning, some dark and cold . G D There is a Spirit who brings a fire .G C D G Ignites a candle and makes His home
[C1] . G C Carry your candle, run to the darkness . G D Seek out the helpless, confused and torn . G C Hold out your candle for all to see it . G D B Em C Take your candle, and go light your world . G D G Take your candle, and go light your world
[V2] . G D Frustrated brother, see how he's tried to . C G D Light his own candle some other way . G See now your sister, she's been robbed and lied to . G C D G Still holds a candle without a flame
[C2] . G C Carry your candle, run to the darkness . G D Seek out the helpless, confused and torn . G C Hold out your candle for all to see it . G D B Em C Take your candle, and go light your world . G D G Take your candle, and go light your world
[V3] . G D 'Cause we are a family whose hearts are blazing . C G D So let's raise our candles and light up the sky . G D Praying to our Father, in the name of Jesus . G C D G Make us a beacon in darkest times
[C3] . G C Carry your candle, run to the darkness . G D Seek out the helpless, confused and torn . G C Hold out your candle for all to see it . G D B Em C Take your candle, and go light your world . G D G Take your candle, and go light your world
song.title: Go light your world
